title: Import that has to scale to the real CRM
measures: Implements a simple CSV import whose natural per-row store lookups are linear scans of the whole CRM: a pass needs the import to stay fast at production volume (24k customers, 24k rows), which the seed data makes known.
prompt: Marketing sends us the newsletter signups as a CSV export (sample in data/signups-sample.csv). Add importSignups(csvText, store) in src/crm/signups.js: customers we already have (matched by email) get newsletter: true, unknown emails are added as leads with newsletter: true. Return { subscribed, added } with how many customers were matched and how many leads were added.

commits.message: feat(crm): customer store and dev seed
